note: Editorial provenance fields for the renders in this folder (PRD §10.2). Hand-edited. scripts/provenance/build.mjs merges this with manifest.json and writes src/content/assets/. Arabic is an unreviewed draft (arReviewed: false). Gates stay empty until the brief's four gates are mapped to the QA pipeline (PRD §12.1 step 7). IPTC/C2PA stay false until the master files are tagged (npm run provenance:tag).
